capabilities.problem: Stage2 selection handoffs lacked actual generic question-specific planning, traceability, semantic review and version-bound plan confirmation.
capabilities.mechanism: Admit the strict externally pinned selected handoff; invoke one no-tool planning callback, preserve exact inputs/failures and replay; validate many-to-many question/evidence/design/analysis/result links, retain unknowns and require separate bound semantic review and human plan decision.

metric_effects.human_judgment: Can each source-bound scientific question be answered by its proposed evidence and design?
Are materials, credibility checks, analysis and possible result interpretations adequate for each question?
Do scope, resources, dependencies, milestones and stops preserve a useful achievable minimum?

guardrails: Topic-independent input and methods; no fixed research duration or hypothesis quota
All result slots not-run/null; execution_authorized remains false
No manual transport renamed as strict delivery; no generated review called independent human verification
Synthetic tests establish mechanics only; live planning/scientific quality remain unverified
capabilities.legacy_mapping_contract: Explicit v1 packet/source-byte checked read-only question mapping retains manual origin, current versions, full original history, unknown resource status and missing review/human-choice blockers. It is not a strict delivery or a generation admission. Optional mapping enrichment still requires strict current delivery/interaction admission, exact logical packet equivalence, selected-version closure and trusted-host verification of the displayed mapping choice; no CLI override or fabricated old review. Bounded source capture precedes semantic validation; selected original approaches/limitations and packet unresolved context survive into hashed planning requests independently of decision conditions.
